title: Founding of Babel and the Era of the Tower
summary: Men settle in the plain of Shinar and build a city and a tower (Gen 11:1–4); "the beginning of his [Nimrod's] kingdom was Babel" (Gen 10:10). CFAH dates the founding to 2234/2233 BC and the era of the tower to 2233–2191 BC.
description: CFAH-2 dates the founding of Babel / root of Chaldean astronomy to 2234/2233 BC from Callisthenes (1,903 years to Alexander), Berossus/Epigenes (720,000 days), the Embolismal period and Philo of Byblos, confirmed by the vernal-equinox new moon of 9 April 2233 BC; CFAH-5 refers to this as AP-1. Four sources give ~42 years for the tower's construction (Duration 19).

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 2: Founding of the Nations," ARJ 15 (2022): 405–426, sections "The Root of Chaldean Astronomy: Vernal Equinox, 2233 BC", "Era of the Tower of Babel: 2233–2191 BC" and Table 2; designated AP-1 in Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670 ("Griffith and White 2022b, AP-1")
chronologies.note: CFAH-2 "Summary of Durations to Babel" prints "2234/2333 BC", evidently a typo for 2234/2233.
Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002, Chronological Compendium p. 1). Leave empty until verified.

chronologies.date: After the Flood, in the days of Nimrod; no year stated
1771 AM, 2234 BC: start of the 1,903 years of Babylonian astronomical observations to Alexander; Nimrod built Babylon
chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Second Age §49 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
chronologies.note: Ussher narrates the tower-building and confusion of tongues under §47 (1757 AM, 2247 BC heading) without a separate year; §49 gives the astronomical epoch that CFAH also uses.

Jordan gives no year for the founding of Babel: Nimrod, "born around 1759, as I have suggested", had "plenty of time to grow up ... and found a city, Babel"; "the fall of Babel came in 1871" (BC 6:4 §7). Not stated in the Jordan sources read (Biblical Horizons "Biblical Chronology" category, all 9 pages; garynorth.com archive of Biblical Chronology 1989-1996). Left empty, not inferred.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020), ch. 3 "Babel and the Futility of the Kingdoms of Men", PDF p. 69 (printed p. 68)
chronologies.note: Construction of the Tower of Babel, about 100 years after the Flood (Peleg's birth). Timeline Review pairs it with an asterisked 2248 BC (the book's Ussher-chronology equivalent). (p. 78) Differs from the sort year (2234 BC, cfah-anchor) by 184 years.
chronologies.edition_note: 1st ed. (2020); superseded by the 2nd ed. (2024), which prints "2233 BC" (PDF p. 92): 185 years later.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 5 "The Babel Rebellion", PDF p. 92 (printed p. 78)
chronologies.note: Nimrod founds Babel (originally named Kish); also p. 157. p. 99 computes "Babel's dating at 2192 BC" for the end of the Babel era. Differs from the sort year (2234 BC, cfah-anchor) by 1 years.
